headlines.headline: JAMES HARDEN AGREES TO RETURN TO CAVALIERS ON THREE-YEAR, $97M DEAL
headlines.detail: Harden is heading back to Cleveland on a three-year deal with a player option for 2028-29, part of a busy offseason stretch that also saw a multiteam trade send Peyton Watson to the Cavaliers and Max Strus to the Clippers. Russell Westbrook's Aug. 12 retirement closed out an 18-year, nine-time All-Star career.

headlines.headline: PRESEASON WEEK 2 HEADLINED BY HERBERT'S ONE-DRIVE CAMEO, RAIDERS-TEXANS
headlines.detail: Thursday's doubleheader features the Raiders at the Texans and the 49ers at the Chargers, where Justin Herbert is expected to run the first-team offense for exactly one drive. Texans WR Jayden Higgins is out for the season with a torn ACL.

headlines.headline: ALABAMA'S QB BATTLE BETWEEN KEELON RUSSELL AND AUSTIN MACK GOES TO THE WIRE
headlines.detail: The Crimson Tide's starting job remains unsettled between five-star talent Keelon Russell and the steadier Austin Mack as fall camp winds down.

headlines.headline: CALIFORNIA, OKLAHOMA COURTS GRANT ELIGIBILITY TROs, SCRAMBLING LATE-SUMMER PORTAL
headlines.detail: TROs in the 5-in-5 eligibility lawsuit gave players like Donovan Dent and Xaivian Lee (California) and Parsa Fallah (Oklahoma) immediate eligibility and portal access, with over 70 new names now in the portal weeks before the season.
